content: Since Jan 16 2024, Google requires publishers serving ads (AdSense/Ad Manager/AdMob) to EEA/UK users to use a Google-certified CMP integrated with IAB TCF. TCF v2.3 (released June 19 2025) is now current; publishers must migrate by Feb 28 2026 or valid consent strings break and ad serving reverts to 'Limited Ads' (revenue drop 50%+ reported). Free Google-certified CMP options: InMobi CMP (formerly Quantcast Choice) -- free, TCF v2.3 certified, lightweight, Google preset as an IAB vendor by default. Paid options: CookieYes (/domain/mo after free 5000-pageview tier), Cookiebot, Osano.
